# FLX-3669: a forecasts playback or confidence is not usable

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

playback, when present, names a Playback of the bundle. confidence is an exact decimal strictly between 0 and 1, written as a string, and is "0.9" when absent.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3669
```
